m_4cacd9b190: A Place at the Empty Table
m_254de637e2: You found an old table board by the house door. Narin says travelers once shared their food here. To make this place a stop again, you first need to set your own table.
m_6653afb35b: Keep some of your first harvest for yourself. Sell the rest; you should be the first to feel you can stay here.
m_135c939019: A house is ready. Now we need the field that feeds it.
m_17c5e33c79: Look around when you reach the riverbank. Our table won't be filled by fields alone.
m_d071a5d5a7: The first harvest and earnings have arrived. Torin repaired the table board; now you leave tomorrow's tasks upon it. Processing some crops is a way to earn more from the same work.
m_4f32afd67f: You don't have to sell every product raw. Today's order has a processed option too.
m_2a39e24976: A workshop gives us more than a new building. We complete one another's work.
m_149a417a22: Prepare provisions and you can stay by the river longer.
m_4900127174: The workshop can be heard from the house each morning. Part of your watering is in order. You could spend the saved time on a herd; but every new animal means feed set aside for tomorrow.
m_394de626c2: Think of tomorrow before putting feed in the sale chest. Sometimes the goods you keep are worth more.
m_8de207b3a2: Let's increase shelter capacity before growing the herd. We don't want a cramped home.
m_bce14d2757: If we all return home tonight, we can plan the morning's work together.
m_fe23569b68: The farm yields more than crops now. Milk, eggs and processed goods let you prepare provisions for travel. Completing collection chests turns daily work into preparation for a greater expedition.
m_b7a49f71ba: Turn today's surplus into tomorrow's provisions. Remember to set aside order materials too.
m_ed47790dad: Production has grown. The pieces you donate to collection chests will prepare new paths.
m_64b50aaf40: Don't explore empty-handed. Have something to eat on the road and something to tell when you return.
m_a06d8c07cd: You have a working village; the goal is more than getting through the day now. The mine's depths demand better equipment. Drawings on the table board grow: a safe road to travel and a home to return to.
m_39ded082a8: Having more to do doesn't mean it all has to be done in one day.
m_f030788a07: Check your tools and protection before going deep. Let the village's work protect you there too.
m_55d01d0aa5: Explore with the return journey in mind. The best journey brings you home to tell its story.
m_bc6c39ff17: Your marks now sit beside the board's old scratches. You haven't finished the valley; you've built a way to live here. Which corner becomes an orchard and which path a meeting place is yours to decide.
m_741bc8d1da: There is a place at this table now for food you've grown.
m_54176e2ce7: I remember that first day's house. Together we gave everything around it meaning.
m_65479b33ac: We can go somewhere new tomorrow. Sitting here today is lovely too.

steps.title: First steps
steps.intro: Build a home at your own pace. This optional guide does not lock quests or grant rewards.
steps.movement: Walk with WASD/arrows or click clear ground. On touch screens, use the joystick; drag the world to move the camera.
steps.shared: In a shared farm these counters describe shared progress. Menus do not pause your friends; check your own bag too.
steps.showHud: Show First steps in the HUD
steps.complete: The foundations are in place. Choose your own path: farming, crafting, village life or exploration.
steps.noAutoAction: These buttons only select a tool or open a menu. Using items, crafting and buying remain your choice.
steps.rewards: Check the journal for ready quest rewards
steps.gather.title: Gather wood
steps.gather.help: Select the axe, then tap or click a tree near the village. Your character approaches and works once; select it again to continue. The quest counts gathered wood, not the wood you started with.
steps.till.title: Prepare the soil
steps.till.help: Use the hoe on grass without resources, buildings or crops. Prepare four new tiles; the prepared starter plot does not count. A hoe used on a crop removes it.
steps.plant.title: Plant seeds
steps.plant.help: Select wheat seed and plant on empty tilled soil. Aim for six plantings, then water them. Dry or out-of-season crops wait to grow. Menus pause the device farm; return to the world for growth to continue.
steps.harvest.title: Take your first harvest
steps.harvest.help: Use your hand on the ripe golden wheat in the starter plot. Your own wheat takes about 65 seconds of active play while watered. Harvest with your hand, not the hoe; keep the seed if you want to replant.
steps.craft.title: Craft something
steps.craft.help: Try turning 3 wood into 2 planks in Production. Materials are reserved when the job starts; only the first queued job advances. In a device farm, close the menu and allow about 7 seconds of active play.
steps.sell.title: Make a selling decision
steps.sell.help: Open Sell at the market. Selling earns gold, but keeping seeds, food and building supplies is also a choice. Buying them back costs more. This step asks for one sale; the 300-gold quest continues separately.
steps.build.title: Choose a first improvement
steps.build.help: Compare the workshop, storage chest and coop in Build. Gathering missing materials is a useful next goal. Supplies are spent only when you place a building; your home and market are already there.
tools.title: Tool notes and upgrades
tools.scope: After choosing a target, your character may first walk closer. When the work finishes, look for the gain message, sound and small particles. In a shared farm, wait for the result if the connection is slow.
tools.axe.help: Use on trees. A basic hit yields 3 wood and 1 fiber; upgrades collect remaining node units in fewer hits. They do not multiply the total yield of a node.
tools.pickaxe.help: Use on stone and ore. Higher tiers gather more of the remaining node units per hit; the total ore stock is preserved.
tools.hoe.help: Prepares empty grass or paths for planting. It can remove an existing crop; removal costs half the tilling energy shown here. Use your hand to harvest.
tools.water.help: Waters tilled soil. An already very wet tile uses no extra energy. You do not need to refill the watering can.
tools.sword.help: Strikes a nearby enemy in line of sight, within less than 2.4 tiles. It uses no energy and has a cooldown. Tiers and combat skill increase damage.
tools.fish.help: Approach the bank and select water once; selecting it again restarts the cast. Wait 3.4 seconds of active play; a fish is not guaranteed. Skill, talents and friendship with Lale affect the chance.
tools.power: Up to {power} node units per hit, limited by remaining stock.
tools.water.name: Watering can
touch.settingsHelp: Saved on this device. Selecting a tool uses nothing; release an action button once to act.
storage.choose: Choose an item, check the direction, then confirm. Selection never moves stock.
storage.authority: Stock and capacity are checked again on transfer. Online counts change after server approval.

launch.features: Farm, craft and explore in an original 3D browser world. Play a device farm or share a surface farm with up to four players. English and Turkish.
